# Ariya

> Ariya is a free, open-source modern Android music player with a beautiful interface, synced lyrics, FLAC lossless audio, playlists, queue controls, and music discovery from multiple sources.

Ariya is free and open source (MIT license). It requires Android 8.0 (Oreo) or later, supports arm64/armv7/x86/x86_64, and needs about 30 MB of free storage. It is currently Android-only; iOS is not supported.

## Key facts

- Name: Ariya (Ariya Music Player)
- Price: Free (0 USD)
- Platform: Android 8.0+
- Category: Music / Audio player
- Audio: FLAC lossless, gapless playback, crossfade, low to ultra-high quality
- Lyrics: Synced lyrics
- License: MIT (open source)
- Support: [Discord](https://discord.gg/CxMV79wrMP)
- Bug reports: [Support form](https://ariyamusic.us.ci/#support)
